text: OneKey-Models 是面向 DSH 网页端的 TokenDance 模型接入插件。它通过 OAuth 获取并保存 API Key，再把在线模型目录发布到 DSH 模型路由器，让用户挑选要显示的模型。插件还提供模型目录查询、对话、图片与视频生成及 Jev 判断工具，并补充模型价格、上下文和模态信息。适合希望在一个模型列表中使用 TokenDance 多种模型的 DSH 用户；使用前需完成 TokenDance 授权。

OneKey-Models connects DSH web to TokenDance. OAuth obtains the API key, then the live catalog is published to DSH for model selection. Tools support model lookup, chat, image and video generation, and typed decisions. TokenDance authorization is required.
想把 TokenDance 的模型接进 DSH 模型列表并自己挑选可见模型。
有没有办法在 DSH 里用一个目录查找可用的聊天和生图模型？
I want to generate pictures from a DSH conversation using a model from my provider catalog.
OneKey-Models 的功能「同步并筛选模型」：插件读取 TokenDance 在线模型目录并合并 models.dev 的上下文、价格和模态信息；设置页可搜索、勾选模型，再应用到 DSH 模型列表。
OneKey-Models 的功能「生成图片」：在 DSH 对话中调用图片工具，提供模型 ID 和描述文字，可选尺寸、数量及参考图片；插件按模型协议发送请求并将生成图片带回会话。
OneKey-Models 使用前须知：需通过 TokenDance OAuth 配置 API Key；模型请求和目录访问连接 tokendance.space，目录补充信息从 models.dev 获取。

onekey-models README · Install：Clone the repository, then install it as a DSH bundle:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models.git
```

**In the DSH chat**, ask the agent to install it:

```text
install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/OneKey-Models
```

**Or with npm:**

```bash
npm install onekey-models
node <dsh>/lib/bin.js plugin --profile <profile-name> add ./node_modules/onekey-models
```

onekey-models README · Install：Restart DeepSeek Harness (or the profile session) after installing. The settings page appears under **Settings → Plugins → OneKey-Models**.

> Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19.0. Distributed through the DSH plugin markets, `install_bundle`, npm (`onekey-models`) and this GitHub repository — the same bundle from every channel.

onekey-models README · Features：| | Feature | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **API key management** | OAuth (PKCE) sign-in opens the TokenDance authorization page; the returned key is stored locally in DSH's credentials store and **never appears in source code or logs**. |
| 2 | **Model list configuration** | Fetches the live catalog from `https://tokendance.space/gateway/v1/models`, lets you select multiple models, and choose which ones show up in the model picker (empty selection = show everything). |
| 3 | **Special model configuration** | Image-generation models are wired to their matching application (`openai:image-generations` / `ark:image-generations`); Jev judgment models are wired to the `typesafe:systemone` protocol — plus video, speech, audio, music, search, embedding and rerank models. |
| 4 | **Core capabilities** | Chat, image generation, video generation and multimodal (text + image) input work out of the box, exposed both to the model picker and as five agent tools (`tokendance_models`, `tokendance_chat`, `tokendance_image`, `tokendance_video`, `tokendance_jev`). |
onekey-models README · Features：Enrichment data (logos, pricing, context windows, release dates, modalities) is synced automatically from [models.dev](https://models.dev).

onekey-models README · Catalog at a glance：```
catalog: 108 models from https://tokendance.space/gateway/v1/models
  jev 2 · image 3 · video 18 · embedding 2 · rerank 1
  speech 3 · audio 3 · music 2 · search 3
  routable 71 models

`routable` = models whose protocol maps onto a DSH wire protocol (`openai-completions` / `openai-responses` / `anthropic-messages`) and therefore appear in the model picker.

onekey-models README · What is TokenDance?：**TokenDance is an AI model aggregation gateway** — think of it as one front door to many large models:

- **1 key, 1 base URL** — sign up once, get one API key, point any compatible SDK at one address.
- **108 of the latest, hottest models** — GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, Seedance, Doubao and more, kept up to date.
- **Pay as you go** — no per-vendor accounts, no juggling separate keys and billing pages.

onekey-models README · What is TokenDance?：New to all this? The short version: instead of registering with a dozen AI vendors and copying a dozen keys, you register once with TokenDance and this plugin wires every model straight into DeepSeek Harness's model picker.

This plugin does the wiring for you: **install → sign in once → pick your models → they appear in the picker.**

onekey-models README · How it works：```text
┌─────────────────┐   OAuth (PKCE)    ┌──────────────────────┐
│ DeepSeek Harness │ ───────────────▶ │ tokendance.space      │
│  OneKey-Models   │ ◀─────────────── │  authorization page   │
└────────┬────────┘   API key (local) └──────────────────────┘

onekey-models README · How it works：1. **Sign in** — the plugin opens the TokenDance authorization URL, receives a one-time code on a loopback callback, exchanges it for an API key, and stores it via DSH's credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, mode `600`).
2. **Pick models** — the live catalog is fetched, enriched with models.dev metadata, and written into the `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace as a provider block.
3. **Use them** — selected models show up in the model picker; image and Jev models additionally get dedicated tools, and any picture or video can be requested from a chat prompt.
onekey-models README · How it works：All local HTTP endpoints are guarded by a loopback + `sec-fetch-site` trust fence (inbound requests must come from the local origin, never a cross-site page).

onekey-models README · Testing：```bash
npm test              # 71 unit tests (node:test)
npm run check:catalog # live catalog acceptance (108 models, 71 routable)
```
The unit suite covers config normalization, catalog mapping, the settings patch whitelist, Jev question validation, the five video protocols' submit-and-poll shapes, PKCE/OAuth URL construction, the trust fence, credential helpers, and the HTTP layer (exercised against a local stub gateway — no real key required).

onekey-models README · Plugin page：The settings page shows the **“API support provided by TokenDance”** credit, the TokenDance brand mark, and a plain-language introduction of what TokenDance is. Sign-in, the balance card, redeem/top-up (as centered dialogs) and the model list all live on that one page.
onekey-models README · Agent tools：Five tools are registered into the DSH agent registry, so a chat prompt such as *“generate a video of a whale swimming”* becomes a real call:

onekey-models README · Agent tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `tokendance_models` | Lists the live catalog, optionally filtered by capability (`image`, `video`, `chat`…) |
| `tokendance_chat` | One message to one model, with optional images attached |
| `tokendance_image` | Generates an image and returns it straight into the conversation |
| `tokendance_video` | Submits a video task and polls it; resumable by `taskId` |
| `tokendance_jev` | Asks a Jev model for typed decisions (yes/no + probability, choice, score) |

onekey-models README · Agent tools：A companion skill, **`tokendance-media`** (installed to `~/.agents/skills/`), teaches the agent which tool to reach for and how to read the `pending` / `taskId` outcomes. Each tool has its own on/off switch in the plugin's advanced settings.
